import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static final int MAXN = 32;
    static int k;
    static long n;
    static Matrix[][] A = new Matrix[64][32];
    static Matrix[][] prefix = new Matrix[64][32];
    static Matrix[][] suffix = new Matrix[64][32];

    static class Matrix {
        int N;
        int[][] a = new int[MAXN][MAXN];

        void init(int _N, int _V) {
            N = _N;
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                Arrays.fill(a[i], _V);
            }
        }

        void mul(Matrix b) {
            Matrix l = new Matrix();
            Matrix r = new Matrix();
            l.N = N;
            r.N = N;
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                    l.a[i][j] = a[i][j];
                    r.a[i][j] = b.a[i][j];
                }
            }
            int[][] res = new int[N][N];
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                    long t = 0;
                    for (int kIdx = 0; kIdx < N; kIdx++) {
                        t += (long) l.a[i][kIdx] * r.a[kIdx][j];
                    }
                    res[i][j] = (int) (t % MOD);
                }
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                System.arraycopy(res[i], 0, a[i], 0, N);
            }
        }
    }

    static void pre_calc(int i) {
        prefix[i][1] = new Matrix();
        prefix[i][1].init(k + 1, 0);
        for (int j = 0; j <= k; j++) {
            prefix[i][1].a[j][j] = 1;
            prefix[i][1].a[j][i] = 1;
        }
        for (int j = 2; j <= k; j++) {
            prefix[i][j] = new Matrix();
            prefix[i][j].init(k + 1, 0);
            for (int row = 0; row <= k; row++) {
                System.arraycopy(prefix[i][j - 1].a[row], 0, prefix[i][j].a[row], 0, k + 1);
            }
            prefix[i][j].mul(A[i][j - 1]);
        }

        suffix[i][k - 1] = new Matrix();
        suffix[i][k - 1].init(k + 1, 0);
        for (int j = 0; j <= k; j++) {
            suffix[i][k - 1].a[j][j] = 1;
            suffix[i][k - 1].a[j][i] = 1;
        }
        for (int j = k - 2; j >= 0; j--) {
            suffix[i][j] = new Matrix();
            suffix[i][j].init(k + 1, 0);
            for (int row = 0; row <= k; row++) {
                System.arraycopy(suffix[i][j + 1].a[row], 0, suffix[i][j].a[row], 0, k + 1);
            }
            suffix[i][j].mul(suffix[i][j + 1]);
        }
    }

    static int digsum(long n) {
        int s = 0;
        while (n > 0) {
            s = (s + (int) (n % k)) % k;
            n /= k;
        }
        return s;
    }

    static Matrix solve(long n, int m) {
        if (n < k) {
            Matrix mat = new Matrix();
            mat.init(k + 1, 0);
            for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
                mat.a[i][i] = 1;
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                mat.mul(A[m][i]);
            }
            return mat;
        }
        Matrix mat = solve(n / k, m + 1);
        int x = digsum(n / k);
        for (int i = 0; i < n % k; i++) {
            mat.mul(A[m][(x + i) % k]);
        }
        return mat;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            for (int mIdx = 0; mIdx < 64; mIdx++) {
                A[mIdx][i] = new Matrix();
                A[mIdx][i].init(k + 1, 0);
            }
            for (int j = 0; j <= k; j++) {
                A[0][i].a[j][j] = 1;
                A[0][i].a[j][i] = 1;
            }
        }

        int m = 1;
        while (Math.pow(k, m) - 1000 <= n) {
            pre_calc(m - 1);
            for (int x = 0; x < k; x++) {
                A[m][x] = new Matrix();
                A[m][x].init(k + 1, 0);
                for (int row = 0; row <= k; row++) {
                    System.arraycopy(suffix[m - 1][x].a[row], 0, A[m][x].a[row], 0, k + 1);
                }
                if (x > 0) {
                    A[m][x].mul(prefix[m - 1][x]);
                }
            }
            m++;
        }

        Matrix mat = solve(n, 0);
        int ans = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
            ans = (ans + mat.a[k][i]) % MOD;
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
